notes: Official API model ID muse-spark-1.3, the latest Muse Spark version and Meta's recommendation for new work. Text, image, video, audio and PDF input; text output; 1,048,576-token context window. Muse Spark 1.2 and 1.1 remain available at the same Standard price and are not listed separately. Contributor-mode variants trade training use of your content for a lower price and are noted, not listed as separate rows. Availability varies by country under Meta's Geographic Use Policy (restricted territories excluded). Meta does not publish a maximum output length, Batch rate or release date in the API docs; unknown values are not represented as zero.

price_records.billing_note: Standard mode pay-as-you-go pricing on Meta Model API, shared by muse-spark-1.3, 1.2 and 1.1. Cached input applies to tokens served from a cached prompt prefix. No long-context premium. Contributor mode (muse-spark-1.3-contributor) costs $0.10 input, $0.002 cached input and $0.20 output per 1M tokens in exchange for letting Meta use prompts and responses to train future models; it is not used as the default rate. Web search grounding is billed separately at $2.50 per 1,000 queries.
